DATE AND TIME:
Monday, April 25, 2022
06:30 P.M.
NOTICE AND CALL OF A SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Azusa is hereby called to be held Monday, April 25, 2022 at 06:30 p.m. at AZUSA LIGHT & WATER OPEN TO THE PUBLIC.
Said Special Meeting shall be for discussing, hearing and taking action on the items listed below:
AGENDA
A.
PRELIMINARY BUSINESS
1.
Call to Order
2.
Roll Call
3.
Flag Salute
B.
PUBLIC COMMENT Please note that public comments are welcomed by recognition of the
Mayor, and are limited to items listed on this special meeting agenda.
A Person/Group shall be allowed to speak without interruption for up to three (3) minutes maximum time, only on items appearing on this agenda, and only if a vote is taken, in accordance with the Special Meeting Provisions of the Brown Act. Public Comment will be limited to thirty (30) minutes time
C.
SCHEDULED ITEMS
1.
DISCUSSION OF ALLOCATION OF GENERAL FUND EXCESS RESERVES.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Provide direction on allocation of General Fund excess reserves.
C-1 Staff Report - Goals and Priorities
D.
COUNCIL COMMENTS
E.
ADJOURNMENT
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a city meeting, please contact the City Clerk at 626-812-5229. Notification three (3) working days prior to the meeting when special services are needed will assist staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide access to the meeting.
I, Adrian Garcia, MMC, Chief Deputy City Clerk of the City of Azusa, or my designee, hereby certify under penalty of perjury that a true, accurate copy of the foregoing agenda was posted on April 21, 2022, twenty-four (24) hours prior to the meeting per Government Code 54956 at the City Clerk's Office, 213 E. Foothill Blvd.; the lobby of the Police Department, 725 N. Alameda Ave.; the Civic Auditorium, 213 E. Foothill Blvd.; the City Library, 729 N. Dalton Ave.; and on the City's Web Page at www.ci.azusa.ca.us .
Adrian Garcia, MMC
Chief Deputy City Clerk
Azusa City Clerk's Office
minutes_text:
CITY OF AZUSA
  MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL MEETING
  “OFF-SITE CITY FACILITY TOUR”
  SATURDAY, APRIL 16, 2022 – 9:00 A.M.

The City Council of the City of Azusa met in special session at the above date and time in the City Hall Courtyard located
at 213 East Foothill Blvd, Azusa, CA 91702.

SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL

Mayor Gonzales called the Special meeting to order at 9:00 A.M.

CITY COUNCIL ROLL CALL: Roll call was taken by City Clerk Cornejo.

PRESENT: COUNCILMEMBERS: BECKWITH, MENDEZ, AVILA, GONZALES
ABSENT: COUNCILMEMBERS: ALVAREZ

ALSO PRESENT

Elected Officials: City Clerk Cornejo.

Staff Members: City Manager Gonzalez, City Attorney Marco, Chief of Police Wenrick, Director of Administrative
Services Johnson, Director of Public Works/City Engineer Delgadillo, Deputy City Manager DeAnda-Scaia, Director of
Community Resources Carpenter, Director of Economic & Community Development Marquez, and IT and Library
Services Director Graf.

PUBLIC COMMENT

None

SCHEDULED ITEMS

TOUR OF CITY FACILITIES.

The City Council and Staff toured the following locations.

  •  Library: 729 N. Dalton Ave.
  •  Senior Center: 740 N. Dalton Ave.
  •  Women's Club: 1003 N. Azusa Ave.
  •  Scout House: Intersection of Old San Gabriel Cyn. Rd. and Hermitage Ln.
  •  Intersection of Sunset Ave. and Crescent Dr.
  •  Memorial Park: 320 N. Orange Ave.
  •  City owned lot located behind 325 S. Azusa Ave.

No action was taken

COUNCIL COMMENTS

None

ADJOURNMENT

TIME OF ADJOURNMENT: 12:18 P.M.

__________________________________________
CITY CLERK
